metadata.title: Beef Trotter Soup | Home Recipe
metadata.description:
Trotter or Paaya as they are known here in India, are a delightfully gooey and sticky mess which nourishes you as it is full of collagen and protein. 
If you were living in a city you might get a fully processed and cut trotter, however in the rural setup, I just got handed a whole leg. 
To process the trotter, you will need to burn off the hide and hair by charring them, then scrape off the charred layer, wash them clean and with a bone saw or a heavy knife cut it into desired size.
To make the beef trotter soup, you will require the following ingredients;
Beef Trotters
Ginger – 3 inch piece or more
Garlic – 15 – 20 cloves
Turmeric powder – 1 teaspoon
Onion – 1 medium sized
Chilies - optional
Salt to taste

To make the trotters, take the processed trotters and wash them properly and set them aside.

Crush ginger and garlic together.

Heat some oil in a pressure cooker and sauté the ginger garlic paste along with turmeric and add in the chopped onions.

Add in the trotter and let it cook without water for a while and the add some water.

Close the pressure cooker and let it cook for three hours or more, or until the meat/collagen has become very soft.


Thank you for watching, hope you make this dish at home and enjoy a hearty meal. ....
